description: Canonical TAP capability registry — the platform's public authorization vocabulary (e.g. 'grid.read'). This file is the source of truth: tap_auth/capabilities.py loads and validates it, and tap_auth/sync.py hard-syncs the Capability table + projected Django permissions to match it exactly. Capabilities are operation-level (not model-level) in v1; runtime checks resolve them by public name and fail closed on an unknown one. Edit here (reviewed in git) to add or retire a capability — removal must be an explicitly declared prune at sync time, never silent. Risk metadata is DB-queryable so a future AI/Paladin actor can reason about how dangerous an action is without code access. Role-to-capability bundles live in tap_auth.roles.json, not here. See spec-tap-auth-v0 req-tap-auth-capabilities.

capabilities.name: grid.read
capabilities.description: Read TAP graph nodes and edges.

capabilities.name: grid.write
capabilities.description: Create or update TAP graph nodes and edges.

capabilities.name: grid.delete
capabilities.description: Delete (tombstone) TAP graph nodes and edges.

capabilities.name: grid.import_grift
capabilities.description: Import a GRIFT batch into the grid.

capabilities.name: grid.purge
capabilities.description: Irreversibly hard-delete graph data (DEBUG-gated; destroys history).

capabilities.name: auth.manage_users
capabilities.description: Create, modify, deactivate, and manage user/actor accounts.

capabilities.name: auth.manage_sessions
capabilities.description: Invalidate active login sessions (global / per-user / per-session) — the incident-response banhammer. Separable from user management so an IR role can hold it without full account control.

capabilities.name: auth.manage_providers
capabilities.description: Configure authentication providers and identity settings.

capabilities.name: plugins.manage
capabilities.description: Install, enable, disable, or configure plugins.

capabilities.name: ai.delegate
capabilities.description: Delegate bounded authority to AI actors acting on a user's behalf.
